theme.title: Rotation: Growth → Value & Defensives
theme.summary: Consumer Staples (+3.32%) and Utilities (+2.14%) led the market today, while Technology (-2.33%) and Communication Svcs (-1.71%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -1.39% versus +2.33% for defensives and +0.11% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +0.03% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -2.59%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.10%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 14.09% to 19.03, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.63% to $4,040.20, crude oil was little changed at $99.53, and bitcoin slipped 3.28% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
